director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket se fractions, yaani barabar hisse, dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan
Riya, maine kya pasand hai poocha tha; “haan” uska jawab nahi batata. Cricket break mein roti chaar barabar tukdon mein kaatein: tum kitne logi?
step by step samjhao
Riya, dheere chalte hain. Roti ke hisse barabar hon. Chaar barabar hisson mein ek hissa quarter, yaani chauthai hai. Quarter ke liye kitne barabar hisse chahiye?
chhota bolo
Haan Riya, chhota bolungi. Roti ke chaar barabar hisson mein ek quarter, yaani chauthai hai. Quarter ke liye kitne hisse?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, socho: 15 balls ko teen barabar groups mein baantna hai.
pata nahi
Riya, 15 pencils ke teen barabar groups socho; ek group ek-third hai.
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, abhi kuch aur baat karte hain; phir is hisse par lautenge. Kis baare mein baat karni hai?
cricket ke baare mein
Riya, cricket par end mein aayenge. Pichhle steps ho gaye; ek-tihai mein kitne barabar groups hain?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: hindi mein batao
Theek hai, ab Hindi mein. Riya, khaali jagah mein barabar samoohon ki ginti likhni hai. Ek-tihai ka matlab hai ___ barabar samoohon mein se ek; khaali jagah mein kya aayega?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Riya, pehle tum koshish karo; main baad mein madad karungi. Ek-tihai mein kul kitne barabar samooh hain?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: bye
Riya, tum rukna chahti ho. Abhi jaari rakhein, thoda aaraam karein, ya aaj ke liye rokein?
